steps.title: Required
steps.body: Hemisphere H has radius *x* cm and volume 6174*π* cm<sup>3</sup>. A bowl is made by removing an inner hemisphere, leaving 2 cm thickness. Find total surface area in terms of *π*.

steps.title: Find outer radius x .
steps.body:
Find outer radius *x*. Volume of hemisphere $= \\dfrac{2}{3}\\pi r^3$:
$$\\frac{2}{3}\\pi x^3 = 6174\\pi
        \\implies x^3 = \\frac{6174\\times3}{2} = 9261
        \\implies x = \\sqrt\[3\]{9261} = 21\\text{ cm}$$

steps.title: Find inner radius r inner
steps.body:
Find inner radius:
*r*<sub>inner</sub> = 21 − 2 = 19 cm

steps.title: Three surfaces to add 1.
steps.body:
Three surfaces to add:

**1. Outer curved surface** (half-sphere, radius 21):
*A*<sub>1</sub> = 2*π*(21)<sup>2</sup> = 2*π* × 441 = 882*π*

**2. Inner curved surface** (half-sphere, radius 19):
*A*<sub>2</sub> = 2*π*(19)<sup>2</sup> = 2*π* × 361 = 722*π*

**3. Flat annular ring** at the top rim:
*A*<sub>3</sub> = *π*(21)<sup>2</sup> − *π*(19)<sup>2</sup> = *π*(441−361) = 80*π*

steps.title: Total surface area A total
steps.body:
Total surface area:
*A*<sub>total</sub> = 882*π* + 722*π* + 80*π* = 1684*π*

steps.title: Note
steps.body: Three separate surfaces! Missing the flat annular ring is the most common error on this type of question.

$$30x - 12x^2 = 0 \\implies 6x(5-2x) = 0 \\implies x=0\\;\\text{ or }\\;x=\\tfrac{5}{2}=2.5$$
(*x* = 0 gives zero volume, so the meaningful solution is *x* = 2.5.)

steps.title: Second derivative test to confirm
steps.body:
Second derivative test to confirm maximum:
$$\\frac{d^2V}{dx^2} = 30-24x\\;\\Bigg\|\_{x=2.5} = 30 - 60 = -30 \< 0 \\quad \\checkmark\\text{ (maximum)}$$

steps.title: Calculate V max V max
steps.body:
Calculate *V*<sub>max</sub>:
*V*<sub>max</sub> = (2.5)<sup>2</sup> × (15−4×2.5) = 6.25 × 5 = 31.25 cm<sup>3</sup>

steps.title: Note
steps.body: Calculus optimisation: always verify the nature of the stationary point using $\\dfrac{d^2V}{dx^2}$. Also check *x* \> 0 and 15 − 4*x* \> 0 (i.e. *x* \< 3.75) to ensure a valid cuboid.

steps.title: Required
steps.body: Solve *y*<sup>2</sup> + 5*y* + *x*<sup>2</sup> = 12 and *x* = *y* + 5.

steps.title: Substitute x y + 5
steps.body:
Substitute *x* = *y* + 5 into the first equation:
*y*<sup>2</sup> + 5*y* + (*y*+5)<sup>2</sup> = 12

steps.title: Factorise
steps.body:
Factorise:
$$(2y+13)(y+1) = 0 \\implies y = -\\tfrac{13}{2}\\;\\text{ or }\\;y = -1$$

steps.title: Required
steps.body: The graph of *y* = *a*sin (*x*+*b*)<sup>∘</sup> + *c* for 0 ≤ *x* ≤ 360 is shown. Find suitable values for *a*, *b*, and *c*.

steps.title: Read the maximum and minimum
steps.body:
Read the maximum and minimum values from the graph to find the **amplitude** *a* and **vertical shift** *c*:
$$a = \\frac{\\text{max}-\\text{min}}{2} = \\frac{4-(-2)}{2} = 3
        \\qquad
        c = \\frac{\\text{max}+\\text{min}}{2} = \\frac{4+(-2)}{2} = 1$$

steps.title: Find the phase shift b
steps.body:
Find the **phase shift** *b*. The standard sin  has its peak at *x* = 90°. From the graph, the maximum occurs at *x* ≈ 45°:
*x* + *b* = 90° ⟹ 45° + *b* = 90° ⟹ *b* = 45°

steps.title: Verify at x 0 consistent
steps.body: Verify at *x* = 0: $y = 4\\sin(0+45)° = 4\\times\\frac{\\sqrt{2}}{2} \\approx 2.83$ — consistent with graph

steps.title: Note
steps.body: The period of the graph is still 360° (unchanged), so no horizontal stretch is applied.

steps.title: Required
steps.body: Series P: first term *a*, c.d. *d*; *S*<sub>40</sub>(*P*) = 2070. Series Q: first term 2*a*, c.d. 3*d*; 25th term of Q  = 186. Find *S*<sub>40</sub>(*Q*).

steps.title: Form equation from 25th term
steps.body:
Form equation from 25th term of Q  = 186:
*T*<sub>25</sub>(*Q*) = 2*a* + 24(3*d*) = 2*a* + 72*d* = 186
